_comment: Astrolabe sync manifest. The template is the source of truth for FRAMEWORK paths; sync copies them into an instance. PERSONAL paths are NEVER written or deleted by sync (an instance's identity). OBSOLETED paths are deleted from the instance on every sync (former layouts). Sync is additive: it never deletes an instance file that isn't in `obsoleted`.
_comment_emitted_lanes: AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md / .codex/** / .gemini/** / bin/astro are GENERATED by .claude/bin/emit-cli-artifacts.mjs and are classified PERSONAL, not framework. They inline that instance's CLAUDE.md and rules — which for the dev instance includes private branding and venture material — so promoting them would leak personal content into the public-facing template. Each instance regenerates its own lanes; the EMITTER is the framework part, its output is not.
